messages.subject: Project Falcon - first draft Subscription & Shareholders' Agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus, Aisha,

Attached is our first draft of the Subscription and Shareholders' Agreement for your review before we send to Birchall Stone. This is our opening position - note the founder warranty cap is drafted at £4m and survival at 3 years; we expect Westbridge to push these. The non-compete is at 24 months.

Let us know any comments and we'll release to the other side.

James

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
